notes.title: Old School Musical new DLC, the MVExpo is now available! ♫♪
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31217741/22041db6797ef618dd70daa062d9f68b03e1297b.jpg[/img]

It’s finally here, the last DLC of Old School Musical! After the partnership with Toriena last November, Old School Musical is being expanded with one last world for the Chicken Republic Mode, the MVEXpo, with the musical featuring of Xavier “mistermv” Dang.

If you missed our past news, here’s a small recap. This new DLC is a musical partnership with Xavier “mistermv” Dang, a well-known French streamer & composer. He has created various electro / chiptune EPs & is a video game composer for various games including Bokida.

Discover our brand new trailer we made for the release (epilepsy warning, it’s quite colorful)

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=wOEoBYnb-j0
Mistermv grants us the honor of composing 5 new frenzied tracks for this DLC, we hope that you’ll enjoy them as much as we do. Like the previous DLC, you must have finished Old School Musical story mode & unlocked the Chicken Republic Mode and the new levels will be added at the end of the Chicken Republic Mode. The game is also on sale at 50% off for the Steam Summer Sale until July 9 if you still hesitate. :)

You might have understood it already if you follow our news, but it will be last DLC for Old School Musical. We want to thank all the people that supported us since the beginning of the development of the game. This beautiful adventure full of chickens would not have been possible without you. ♥

Reminder of what's coming : 
•	Discover 5 new tracks and challenges
•	Stroll through MV Expo, the world's greatest chicken convention! MV Expo is your chance to dive into the loony universe of the eldest French streamer
•	Brace yourself for the new challenges of Chicken Republic and its new diabolic modifiers
•	The game is 50% off during the Steam Summer sale

Enjoy this new DLC & don’t forget to tell your friends, that really helps us a lot!
 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31217741/24725ab32ce435641fdd8a7fb9551ba3128e2c07.png[/img]

notes.title: Have You Played Old School Musical?
notes.content:
Have You Played? is an endless stream of game retrospectives. One a day, every day, perhaps for all time…

I didn’t expect to be taken on a NES-fuelled fever dream when I first started playing Old School Musical, but this retro-infused rhythm game ended up being one surprise after another. A love letter to the pixel classics of the 8 and 16-bit eras, Old School Musical follows the tale of white square Tib and his younger, taller brother, Rob, as they fight to save the world from being corrupted by a deadly virus. And what better way to do that than by tapping along to sweet chiptune tracks in a DDR-style rhythm battle?

(more…)

notes.title: Old School Musical has a new FREE DLC, feat. the talented Chiptune DJ, TORIENA!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31217741/0713e4ae3394ce5a24970f801ccc78fbda483473.jpg[/img]

One year after the release of Old School Musical on PC, the wacky rhythm game by the studio La Moutarde comes back with new content! To celebrate the Japanese release of the game on Nintendo Switch, a new world is being added on all versions today to the Chicken Republic Mode: Toricity! This new area comes with 5 levels & 5 amazing new tracks by TORIENA, a famous Japanese chiptune DJ who craft great tracks with her Gameboy since 2012.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31217741/18ccb4e85e564f94f692d77ba61702b0d635f648.jpg[/img]

Last but not least, this new DLC is FREE! To get it, you can use the following method:

-	Go to Old School Musical store page on Steam, scroll & click on the Toricity DLC button below the videos. When the DLC is downloaded & installed, a new area will appear at the end of the Chicken Republic Mode.

Note: The DLC is available to download but you can only play it after you have unlocked the Chicken Republic mode by finishing the Story Mode.

You can already check one of the new tracks here:

https://youtu.be/hlGDaZ2gbg8
We hope you’ll have a great time playing these new levels (coming with many new modifiers & chickens 😉) & we can already reveal that this DLC will probably not be the only one coming! We also want to take time to thank you all for your support since the release, see you soon!

Also, the game is 40% off on PC until November 14!

notes.title: Chiptune Music in Old School Musical
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31217741/95938c52ea85e14571766bae0894ef0fc0e5d2b1.png[/img]

Join Old School Musical’s fellowship(tune)! As you already know, Old School Musical is a wacky [b]rhythm game[/b] (no, really?). And what would a rhythm game be without an [b]epic soundtrack[/b]? As both [b]music[/b] and [b]retro video games[/b] lovers, we wanted to combine our two passions for our debut game, and deliver the most [b]perfect OST[/b] for OSM. And what would be [b]better[/b] than the melodies that rocked our childhood? Everybody say “weeee” to [b]chiptune[/b]! “Ok, you impertinent rascal, but what’s chiptune?” you might ask. Say no more, here’s a presentation of this unappreciated musical stream to sound more sophisticated to your next garden party. 

The chiptune music genre, also known as [b]chip music[/b] or [b]8-bit music[/b], appeared in the [b]early 80s[/b], as personal computers, video games consoles and arcade machines became more popular and accessible to everyone. Its unlikely name refers to the [b]8-bit sounds old computer systems[/b] and [b]retro consoles[/b] made: technology is here used as [b]core instrument[/b] of this music style. Video games from the 80s and 90s highly integrated these sounds to create [b]epic soundtracks[/b], which became [b]emblematic[/b] of the period; what would your [b]favourite retro game[/b] be without its [b]iconic theme[/b]? Yes, I’m asking you, dear sir & madam!

Today, chiptune has made a name for itself and became a genre in its own right, derived from [b]synthwave[/b] and more widely [b]electronic music[/b]. Many talented artists proudly represent it, including our dear friend [b]Dubmood[/b], who composed, alongside [b]Zabutom[/b], [b]Hello World[/b], [b]Yponeko[/b] and [b]Le Plancton[/b], OSM’s soundtrack. We can’t wait for you to discover over 50 chiptune tracks in Old School Musical, and we sincerely hope that you’ll enjoy it as much as we do! The OST will soon be available on [b]music platforms[/b], so you know what to play for your next garden party (you naughty boys and gals)!

While waiting for the game to be released, you can already [b]check[/b] our amazing chiptune artists [b]discography[/b]:

notes.title: Chickens - Time for revenge!
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31217741/65cde3588f126dbf57afb61273d33bdff8fd7b11.png[/img]

After being martyrized and humiliated in so many video games, [b]chickens[/b] are ready to take over in [b]Old School Musical[/b]! Discover the true face of these dreaded hen-nemies that you will egg-counter more than once…

First of all, a [b]simple question[/b]: what is a chicken ([b]yes[/b], it’s important)? Also called [i]Gallus gallus domesticus[/i] (thanks Wikipedia), the chicken is the most common and widespread type of domesticated fowl. It is omnivorous, and eats mostly seeds and insects it can find by scratching at the soil with its gracious claw. It is [b]proud[/b], [b]magnificent[/b] and its [b]blazing feathering[/b] perfectly matches with its [b]delicate singing[/b].

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31217741/2a6e71670adf46abea331bd51310ed20fc355165.png[/img]

However, the [b]vicious creatures[/b] from Old School Musical are nothing like this [b]magnificent bird[/b]… Exiled for many years to flee from their [b]tragic destiny[/b], they decided to create a safe haven where they could live in harmony. Lead by mighty [b]King Fabrice[/b], they built a fierce [b]army[/b] to [b]egg-sterminate[/b] anyone who could [b]nug-get[/b] in their way and break their peace apart. To put it in a nutshell, a moving story that gives you [b]chicken bumps[/b] (I’m not even sorry).
 
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31217741/f2c602b33a1a2b6e3ce5c4c98883b89de71a01a7.png[/img]

Welcome… To the [b]Chicken Republic[/b]! In spite of many external attempts to destroy this young Republic, King Fabrice always managed to keep the [b]hen-dependance[/b] of his lands. But Tib and Rob’s sudden arrival might turn their [b]“cluck” around[/b]…

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31217741/68c0a6eecebcaf0472d64e724cc1de3623a50da5.png[/img]

Old School Musical is a [b]retro rhythm game[/b] with a unique [b]chiptune soundtrack[/b] that will send you back directly to the golden years of the [b]8-bit era[/b]. The main protagonists, Tib and Rob, have been trained to become video game heroes. One fateful day, their game gets corrupted by a [b]bug invasion[/b], thus pushing them to embark on an unlikely journey to [b]find their missing mother[/b] and [b]save our childhood games[/b]! Your skill, their success: miss notes and Tib and Rob's adventure will fall flat… Literally! 

Swing a crowbar, shoot with your spacecraft and defeat an evil chicken army to the beat of chiptune tracks from famous artists such as [b]Dubmood, Zabutom, Hello World, Yponeko[/b] and [b]Le Plancton[/b]. Discover over [b]50 tracks[/b], composed exclusively for the game! The OST will be [b]available for purchase[/b] on Steam and other music platforms.

- [b]Arcade Mode[/b]: Reach the highest score and challenge your friends (if you have any)
- [b]Challenge Mode[/b]: Play it hard with visual and audio penalties to unlock new music tracks
- [b]50+ chiptune tracks[/b] by the best of the chiptune scene: Dubmood, Zabutom, Hello World, Yponeko, Le Plancton
- Travel through [b]20+ retro levels[/b], inspired by our childhood games
- A [b]multiplayer mode[/b] with up to [b]4 players[/b]
- [b]Chickens[/b]
